definitions.explanation: The day that was two days ago. Part of the sequence: おととい (day before yesterday) → きのう (yesterday) → きょう (today).

examples.japanese: おととい⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Tokyo the day before yesterday.
It rained the night before last.

examples.japanese: おととい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I've had a cold since the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: おととい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いました→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met my friend at the station the morning of the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: おととい⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一|いっ}{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧⟦{買|か}いに→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The book I bought the day before yesterday was very interesting, so I went to buy another one yesterday.

notes:
おととい means "the day before yesterday." Usually written in hiragana, though the kanji {一昨日|おととい} exists.

TIME SEQUENCE:
- おととい: day before yesterday
- ⟦きのう→昨日：00859_kinou⟧: yesterday
- ⟦きょう→今日：00496_kyou⟧: today
- ⟦あした→明日：00501_ashita⟧: tomorrow
- ⟦あさって→あさって：00828_asatte⟧: day after tomorrow

COMMON PATTERNS:
Like other time words, おととい can modify a verb directly without a particle:
- おととい⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧ (I went the day before yesterday)

VARIANT READINGS:
- おとつい: casual/dialectal pronunciation
- いっさくじつ: formal reading of ⟦{一昨日|いっさくじつ}→一昨日：16681_issakujitsu⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{一昨年|おととし}→一昨年：02895_ototoshi⟧: year before last
